Welcome to Fell for My Monster Boss. Young marine researcher Maren boldly pursues her mysterious boss Calder, a terrifying deep sea royal hiding monstrous power beneath a cold exterior. As deep sea secrets are exposed, water pressures rise, and the ruthless queen Nerissa threatens their world, can this forbidden romance survive? Dive into a thrilling journey filled with intense workplace tension, dangerous attraction, and high stakes rescue missions across 48 gripping episodes. Watch episode one right now to uncover the deadly truth hidden beneath the ocean surface and subscribe for more amazing short dramas.
